zh.description: 在首篇小信号试点基础上，加入完整阶跃序列、参数表对照和独立平均模型。
algorithm: 按式 (19) 重建极点和零点；在零电流点检查参考前馈的极零相消。
分别使用原文标幺值和从欧姆换算的有源电阻，重跑两种网强下的 PSC 与 RFPSC。
用电网同步坐标系重新实现方程，独立比较轨迹。
strengths: 受测的平均模型工况下，RFPSC 减弱了 PSC 的有功振荡；零电流点相消得到支持。
limitations: 带载时不能把零电流条件下的极零相消推广为精确相消。模型未包含硬件限流和保护。
gaps: 表 I 的有源电阻欧姆值与标幺值不一致。缺原始波形、原固件与完整实验寄生参数。
zh.caption: 基于原文标幺值重算的 PSC 与 RFPSC 有功功率响应。

en.description: Extends the small-signal pilot with complete step sequences, two interpretations of the parameter table, and an independent averaged model.
algorithm: Rebuild poles and zeros from Eq. (19) and test reference-feedforward cancellation at zero current.
Run PSC and RFPSC at two grid strengths using the printed per-unit active resistance and the ohmic value converted to per unit.
Reimplement the equations in grid-synchronous coordinates and compare trajectories.
strengths: In the tested averaged model, RFPSC reduced the oscillation seen with PSC. The zero-current cancellation was supported.
limitations: The exact cancellation at zero current does not generally carry over to loaded conditions. The model excludes hardware limiters and protection.
gaps: Table I gives inconsistent ohmic and per-unit active resistance. Raw waveforms, firmware and full experimental parasitics are unavailable.
en.caption: Computed PSC and RFPSC active-power responses using the printed per-unit parameters.

zh.description: 复核单变流器 PSC 暂态稳定边界，并检查故障清除时的电流是否越限。
algorithm: 用故障前、中、后的网络导纳建立相角标量模型。
按吸引区边界求临界清除角和时间，对照两套参数口径。
用独立的戴维南等效和标量闭式流对照数值轨迹。
strengths: 相图可解释在早清除和未清除工况下的不同收敛行为。
limitations: 0.7 s 晚清除算例超过 1.8 p.u. 电流门槛。标量模型中重新同步的结果不能代表实际限流系统。
gaps: 缺原始 EMT 和硬件波形、内环设置和限流切换逻辑。SI 电感及控制增益的归一化需要推断。
zh.caption: 根据冻结协议重新计算的相图。

en.description: Checks the scalar transient stability boundary for a single converter with PSC and tests whether fault clearance exceeds the current threshold.
algorithm: Build a scalar angle model using network admittance before, during and after the fault.
Compute the critical clearing angle and time from the attraction boundary under two parameter conventions.
Compare trajectories with an independent Thévenin-equivalent and closed-form scalar flow.
strengths: The phase portrait explains the different convergence behaviors after early clearance and when the fault persists.
limitations: The 0.7 s late-clearance case exceeds the 1.8 p.u. current threshold. Recapture in the scalar model does not establish recapture in a current-limited converter.
gaps: Raw EMT and hardware traces, inner-loop settings and current-limiter transitions are unavailable. The SI inductance and gain normalization require inference.
en.caption: Phase portraits calculated from the frozen protocol.

zh.description: 复核 PSC 解析整定与稳定裕度，分别保留原图图注工况和反推工况。
algorithm: 重建功率同步环和直流电压环，计算频响与稳定裕度。
按原图图注及从曲线推断的两种无功电流条件运行图 5。
独立重算中间公式与图 8，比较两套频响。
metrics: SCR=1 高无功时直流相位裕度
图 5 灵敏度峰值最小的 SCR（图注 / 反推）
strengths: 解析整定可用于解释受测条件下的稳定裕度。
limitations: 高无功注入加上极弱电网时，直流环相位裕度显著变小。附录若干中间公式与独立推导不一致。
gaps: 表 I 的有源电阻单位不一致；图 7–8 滤波带宽沿用算例 1。缺原始硬件波形、限幅与延迟等数据。
zh.caption: 按图注和曲线反推的两种工况重算图 5 的裕度与灵敏度。

en.description: Checks analytical PSC tuning and stability margins, preserving both the caption and curve-inferred cases.
algorithm: Rebuild the power synchronization and DC voltage loops and compute frequency responses and stability margins.
Evaluate Fig. 5 under the captioned reactive current and the value inferred from its curves.
Independently rederive intermediate equations and Fig. 8, then compare frequency responses.
metrics: DC phase margin at SCR=1 with high reactive injection
SCR with lowest peak sensitivity in Fig. 5 (caption / inferred)
strengths: Analytical tuning helps explain the stability margins in the tested cases.
limitations: High reactive injection in a very weak grid reduces the DC loop phase margin. Several intermediate appendix expressions disagree with the independent derivation.
gaps: Table I gives inconsistent active resistance units. The Fig. 7–8 filter bandwidth is inherited from Example 1. Raw hardware traces, limiter settings and delays are unavailable.
en.caption: Computed Fig. 5 margins and sensitivity under the captioned and inferred cases.

zh.description: 复核扰动观测器构网控制方程，量化弱网出版波形与仿真的差距。
algorithm: 实现平均模型与独立电网坐标实现，比较 DO-GFM 和 RFPSC。
检查电感失配、50→49 Hz 频率斜坡与 GFM/GFL 切换。
在相同指令下用 motulator PWM 重跑，并对照出版图读数。
metrics: 弱网 DO-GFM 上升时间：平均 / PWM / 出版图
弱网 DO-GFM 无功平台：平均 / PWM / 出版图
strengths: 两套方程实现支持受测工况下的基本控制机制。
limitations: 弱网下两种仿真都未定量重现原图的上升时间和无功平台；部分 P–f 表达式的符号与数值微分不一致。
gaps: 缺实际数字离散化、端电压、对象电阻与器件延时。故障穿越、LCL 与硬件直流母线超出验证范围。
zh.caption: 平均模型的电感失配扫描。

en.description: Checks the disturbance-observer grid-forming equations and quantifies the weak-grid gap between the published plot and simulations.
algorithm: Implement an averaged model and independent grid-frame equations; compare DO-GFM with RFPSC.
Check inductance mismatch, a 50→49 Hz frequency ramp and transitions between GFM and GFL.
Replay the same commands with motulator PWM and compare to values read from the published plot.
metrics: Weak-grid DO-GFM rise time: average / PWM / published plot
Weak-grid DO-GFM reactive plateau: average / PWM / published plot
strengths: The two equation implementations support the tested control mechanisms.
limitations: Neither simulation matches the published weak-grid rise time and reactive plateau quantitatively. A printed P–f expression has a sign discrepancy relative to numerical differentiation.
gaps: The exact digital implementation, terminal voltage, plant resistance and device delays are unavailable. Fault ride-through, LCL and hardware DC bus validation are outside scope.
en.caption: Inductance mismatch sweep of the averaged model.

zh.description: 对谐振升压算例做 DMM 离线重算，区分数值等价、映射规模和实时性能。
algorithm: 用梯形积分建立开关电阻电路模型。
预编译二极管可行区及仿射映射，逐步查询得到下一状态。
以同一步长的独立迭代 tableau 作数值基线。
metrics: 同一步长下最大相对 L² 误差
轨迹访问的二极管组合
strengths: 该算例的映射查表与同一步长的独立迭代解高度一致。
limitations: 10 个是该轨迹访问的模式；无额外限制的历史域并未复现原文的映射规模。与论文图读回仍有定量差距。
gaps: 缺该算例的开关电阻、初值、事件量化、完整 EMTP 算例和映射表。未验证 FPGA 时序、定点精度或资源。
zh.caption: 100 ns 步长下的离线谐振升压波形。

en.description: Replays DMM offline on the resonant boost case, separating numerical agreement, mapping size and real-time performance.
algorithm: Discretize the resistive switching circuit with the trapezoidal rule.
Compile feasible diode regions and affine maps, then look up the next state at each step.
Use an independently assembled iterative tableau at the same step as the reference.
metrics: Diode combinations visited on the trajectory
strengths: The map lookup closely agrees with the independent iterative reference at the same step size in this case.
limitations: The trajectory visits ten modes; the unrestricted history domain does not reproduce the published map size. A quantitative gap remains against the published plot readback.
gaps: Case-specific switch resistance, initialization, event quantization, the full EMTP case and lookup tables are unavailable. FPGA timing, fixed-point accuracy and resources were not verified.
en.caption: Offline resonant boost waveforms at a 100 ns step.

zh.description: 已完成资料审计，原文工况复现暂缓。
algorithm: 检查滑模观测器、延时补偿、PI 设置与采样时序。
limitations: 未按原文工况运行仿真。
gaps: 缺实际观测器增益 k、误差阈值 ξ、速度与电流 PI、离散更新顺序，以及同步的 ADC/PWM 时序和原始波形。

en.description: Source audit complete; reproduction of the published cases is on hold.
algorithm: Check the sliding-mode observer, delay compensation, PI settings and sampling schedule.
limitations: No simulation of the original cases was executed.
gaps: The numeric observer gain k, error tolerance ξ, speed and current PI settings, discrete update order, synchronized ADC/PWM timing and raw waveforms are unavailable.
